label: FLM formula test in a trapped-ion HaPPY code
summary: The authors report experimental confirmation of the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula in a trapped-ion implementation of the HaPPY holographic code.

summary: The authors report observing entropic precursors expected of emergent gravity after introducing non-stabilizerness into their holographic-code model.

label: Nearly simultaneous arrival of widely separated photon energies from GRB 090510
summary: NASA reports that two photons from GRB 090510, differing in energy by a factor of one million, arrived at Fermi nearly simultaneously after traveling more than 7.3 billion light-years.

label: GRB 090510 constraint on energy-dependent light speed
summary: NASA reports that GRB 090510 placed a strong constraint on variation of light speed with photon energy, with high- and low-energy gamma rays arriving within one second after traveling approximately seven billion light-years.

label: Fermi GBM detector coverage and burst detection rate
summary: NASA describes the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor as having 14 detectors covering the unobscured sky, detecting approximately 240 gamma-ray bursts per year across an energy range of 8 keV to 40 MeV.
